factual_claims.claim: More than 200 papers have been written on how machine learning can fail because of adversarial attacks on the algorithms and data in the last two years.

In a medical dataset where the goal is to predict the dosage of anticoagulant drug Warfarin, researchers introduced malicious samples at an 8% poisoning rate, which changed dosage by 75.06% for half of patients.

Researchers were able to reconstruct faces from a decision tree model using only the name and access to the model, allowing workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to identify an individual from a line-up with 95% accuracy.
Researchers were able to recover the model used to predict credit risk (German Credit Card dataset) using 1,150 queries within 10 minutes.
There are 22 models in the Caffe model repository without any SHA1 hash for integrity checks.
